app.tagline: Your model does not pass unless it proves it passes.
app.privacy: Everything runs on your computer. Your model never leaves it.
app.start_failed: VeriModel could not start. Close and reopen the window.
stepper.label: Progress
tip.ids: Information Delivery Specification: a standard file (buildingSMART) in which a client lists what information each kind of element must carry, such as "every wall has a fire rating".
tip.bcf: BIM Collaboration Format: a standard file of issues. Each failure becomes an issue you can open in Revit, Navisworks, Solibri, BIMcollab and similar tools.
tip.globalid: The unique 22-character identifier of an element inside an IFC file. Paste it in your authoring tool to find the element.
tip.pset: A named group of properties attached to an element, for example Pset_WallCommon holds FireRating and IsExternal.
tip.schema: The IFC version the file was written in (IFC2X3, IFC4, IFC4X3). It decides which element types and properties can exist.
tip.qto: Quantity takeoff: counting and measuring elements (number, length, area, volume) so they can be scheduled and priced.
tip.config: A small text file with your project settings: which rules to use, tolerances, classification and how quantities are grouped. Every field is optional.

export.title: Export
export.lede: Everything below was written to your output folder. Share the report, send the issues to your team, and keep the audit files as proof.
export.downloads_sub: Open any file with your usual program.
export.browser_open: In the desktop app this opens {path}.
export.bcf_line: {topics} issues, {viewpoints} with a 3D viewpoint · BCF version {version}
export.kind.report_html.title: Quality report
export.kind.report_html.desc: A single page you can email or print: score, verdict, every check, failures, quantities and IDS results. No internet needed to open it.
export.kind.failures_csv.title: Failures list
export.kind.failures_csv.desc: One row per failure, ready for Excel: rule, element, problem and how to fix it.
export.kind.bcf.title: Issues (BCF)
export.kind.bcf.desc: One issue per failure with a 3D viewpoint. Import it in Revit, Navisworks, Solibri or BIMcollab to send the problems back to the modellers.
export.kind.issues_csv.title: Issues list
export.kind.issues_csv.desc: The same issues as the BCF file in a spreadsheet, for people who do not use a BIM viewer.
export.kind.qto_xlsx.title: Quantities (Excel)
export.kind.qto_xlsx.desc: The quantity takeoff as an Excel workbook, grouped as you chose, with totals and costs when unit rates were given.
export.kind.qto_csv.title: Quantities (CSV)
export.kind.qto_csv.desc: The same quantity takeoff as plain text, for importing into other tools.
export.kind.qto_json.title: Quantities (JSON)
export.kind.qto_json.desc: The quantity takeoff in a machine-readable form, for scripts and integrations.
export.kind.report_json.title: Full result (JSON)
export.kind.report_json.desc: Every number and finding in one machine-readable file. The same input always produces the same file.
export.kind.config.title: Settings used
export.kind.config.desc: The exact project settings of this run, so you or a colleague can repeat it.
export.kind.run_json.title: Run record
export.kind.run_json.desc: When the check ran, how long it took and fingerprints (SHA-256) of every input and of the report, as proof of what was checked.
export.kind.audit_log.title: Audit log
export.kind.audit_log.desc: A step-by-step text log of what the tool did, for audits and for diagnosing problems.
export.kind.other.desc: An additional file produced by this run.
